nodes.label: Evidence Governance
nodes.rationale: Untrusted inputs must not be silently promoted to trusted RAG, and policy enforcement is preferred over model prompts.

nodes.label: SQL-First Retrieval Verification
nodes.rationale: A synthetic fixture must verify document/page/chunk rows, scopes, filters, ordering, and citations before a model receives evidence.

nodes.label: Private Document Privacy
nodes.rationale: Personal documents are private by default and must retain version, hash, pages, collection, permissions, and provenance.

nodes.label: Lynk
nodes.rationale: A local, evidence-governed research agent that produces reviewable cited briefings before information enters long-term RAG.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL pgvector Store
nodes.rationale: The long-term local RAG store combines relational filters, JSONB metadata, full-text indexes, and future semantic embeddings.

nodes.label: Local Model Runtime
nodes.rationale: Lynk calls an already-running local Ollama or Open WebUI runtime without cloud fallback or model download.

nodes.label: Local Evidence Drafting
nodes.rationale: Authorized local chunks are passed to a local model for citation-bound drafts; this path does not perform web research or promote RAG evidence.

nodes.label: Governed Retrieval Enforcement Foundation
nodes.rationale: The implementation introduces typed lifecycle, review, policy-decision, evidence, and chunk records plus governed retrieval boundaries.

nodes.label: Local Retrieval-to-Model Drafting
nodes.rationale: A research command provides a bounded retrieval-to-local-model path with page citations but cannot promote evidence or perform web research.

nodes.label: DocumentIngestor
nodes.rationale: Hashes and stores original documents in a private local directory before page-level extraction.

nodes.label: Page-Level Provenance
nodes.rationale: A document must be traceable to its exact source file and page before it influences a research answer.

nodes.label: Local Git History
nodes.rationale: The local committed working tree is the immediate source of recovery, while GitHub is a synchronized replica.

nodes.label: SQL-First pgvector Retrieval
nodes.rationale: Local PostgreSQL with pgvector is the long-term retrieval source of truth, keeping provenance, permissions, review status, and audit records connected to chunks.

nodes.label: Offline Resilience
nodes.rationale: After installation and caching, local ingestion, retrieval, and inference must work without network access.

nodes.label: Verified Evidence Contract
nodes.rationale: The model receives restricted, verified evidence and cannot use raw database access or invent answers to conceal retrieval failures.

nodes.label: Evidence Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Evidence moves from ingested document to candidate, human review, and approved or rejected state; private context instead requires a collection grant.

nodes.label: Answer Eligibility
nodes.rationale: Only approved curated evidence or explicitly granted private evidence is eligible for grounding; candidate is review-only and rejected is never answer-retrievable.
